title: The Ghost Army That Fooled Hitler
description: A real World War II deception unit that changed the course of battles without firing shots.

scenes.visual_prompt: Foggy dawn over a World War II battlefield. Inflatable tanks slowly rise into shape as air pumps inside them. Canvas surfaces ripple in the wind. Strong motion at frame zero with fog rolling laterally across the ground. No soldiers clearly visible, distant silhouettes only.
scenes.visual_reference: inflatable tanks ww2 battlefield foggy dawn
scenes.negative_prompt: clear faces, modern vehicles, text, watermark, logo, cartoon, low quality, blurry
scenes.narration: During World War Two, an entire army existed that wasn’t real.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide aerial-style shot of fake military camps. Inflatable trucks, tanks, and artillery arranged in formation. Fabric flaps subtly flutter. Tire tracks appear in dirt as if recently driven. Slow cinematic camera drift from left to right.
scenes.visual_reference: fake ww2 military camp inflatable vehicles
scenes.negative_prompt: real combat, explosions, text, watermark, logo, cartoon, low quality, blurry
scenes.narration: They used inflatable tanks and fake camps to look massive from the air.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up ground-level shot of a portable loudspeaker hidden behind crates. Sound waves visually ripple through the air as ghostly silhouettes of marching troops appear in dust. Subtle camera push-in. Dust particles vibrate in sync with the sound illusion.
scenes.negative_prompt: modern speakers, visible text, watermark, logo, cartoon, low quality, blurry
scenes.narration: They played recorded sounds of marching soldiers and moving armor.

scenes.visual_prompt: Nighttime battlefield map dissolves into a real frontline shifting away. Enemy markers retreat on the map overlay. Stars drift slowly overhead. Fade-to-dark motion with gentle zoom out. No humans visible.
scenes.negative_prompt: modern UI, text labels, watermark, logo, cartoon, low quality, blurry
scenes.narration: The enemy moved their forces. The deception worked. They were called the Ghost Army.
